clips.title: The story
paras: Along Duskwood’s western river, Hushed Bank runs from Three Corners toward Stranglethorn Vale. Beasts prowl its quiet shore, where dark mysteries linger.

At Hushed Bank, Duskwood’s western edge follows the river that divides the forest from Westfall. The covered wooden bridge carries travelers west out of the grim wood. Near it, the land shifts from open plains and sunlit farms into unnatural twilight. Thick underbrush and creeping fog crowd the riverbanks. Large spiders and hungry forest wolves stalk wayfarers who stray from the path.
